statement: The system shall have a manipulator that can be used to interact with objects in a reactor.
The system shall have a virtual reality (VR) simulator for training and testing.
The system shall have a feature called Bolt Runner constraints to restrict movement and orientation.
The system shall have numerous high-definition cameras to provide multiple views of the work area.
The system shall have at least two main cameras and additional cameras on the wrists and external cameras for a comprehensive view.
The system shall have a high frame rate to provide a smooth and realistic view.
The system shall have a large display screen to show images from the cameras.
The system shall have a built-in feature to preprogram walls and restricted areas for safe operation.
The system shall have a warning system, such as a buzzer, to alert the operator of over-gripping or incorrect grip.
The system shall be compatible with augmented reality (AR) devices, such as Microsoft HoloLens.
The system shall have a camera with a light source to provide illumination and shadowing for better visualization.
The system shall be able to calculate and display force ratios on the arms to assist with heavy object manipulation.
The system shall have emergency stops located throughout the work area for quick access in case of an emergency.
